data.credibility: Management frequently drops or stops mentioning specific targets, such as store counts and loss reductions, making accountability difficult. While food delivery growth and quick commerce CAGR remain supported, margin and return targets show signs of slipping or lack final delivery.

lines.line: Promised 2,100 Blinkit stores by December quarter, but topic was dropped without reported actual.
Promised 3,000 Blinkit stores by March 2027, but topic was subsequently dropped.
Promised 15% food delivery growth for FY26; actual delivered growth reached 168.6%.
Promised District losses to improve in FY27, but the topic was dropped.
Promised District breakeven in four to six quarters, but the topic was dropped.
Promised 5% to 6% Blinkit margins; actual stands at 3% so far, marking it as slipping.
Promised Blinkit ROCE north of 40%, but the topic was dropped.
Guided 60% quick commerce NOV CAGR over three years, currently tracked as on track.

bull: Consolidated revenue grew 169% YoY to INR 54,364 crore in FY26, with three-year growth accelerating to 97.3% annually.
Quick commerce NOV growth guidance stands at 60% CAGR over the next three years, backed by a 69.49% revenue share.
The balance sheet is lightly geared with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.18, against net worth of INR 31,275 crore.
bear: Blinkit long-term margins were guided to 5% to 6% of NOV, but are currently slipping at 3% in FY27 so far.
Valuation is extremely high with a trailing P/E ratio of 713.0, despite a thin consolidated net profit of INR 493 crore.
ROCE sits low at 2.48% alongside a modest ROE of 0.94%, despite management previously targeting 40% ROCE in Blinkit.
